summary: Candidate 'Maven Project Initialization' is semantically identical to existing skill 'Maven Project Setup and Configuration' (83c71ae7-c88d-5e1b-974c-51a60333a86f). Both cover the same capability: initializing a Maven project with correct structure, POM configuration, and build readiness. The candidate is narrower in scope (archetype-focused, 5–30 min) while the existing skill is broader (includes profiles, plugins, settings.xml). The candidate should merge into the existing skill without creating a duplicate. Peer candidates (plugin development, dependency resolution) are distinct specializations and should remain separate.
